entry.title: On Proof and Progress in Mathematics
entry.summary: William P. Thurston · Why now: Harlev's argument today, that AI-proven results without human understanding shouldn't earn credit, is Thurston's argument from thirty years ago. Thurston wrote that mathematicians aren't after proofs as such but after human understanding, and he described what happened to his foliation-theory subfield when results outran understanding.
